service.description: Create a draft production run (design-manufacturing NewWorkOrder, §12.1's create#ProductionOrder contract): the product checked usable for Produce (check#ProductUsable), Mantle's ManufacturingServices.create#ProductionRun without the legacy consume and produce products (no PatMfgBom row is read or written, D15), WepProductionRun in WeInPlanning owned by the organization (R-SA-03), its own lines (ProductionRunLine: the output, a material line per component Products' released BOM requires as of the method date, now by default, stopping at non-phantom sub-assemblies and blowing phantoms through with their routing, and the by-products) and the WeptConsume/WeptProduce rows planning reads (R-SA-05). The run's revision is 1, its method date, BOM, routing and demand links audit-logged fields. A retry with the same operation key answers the first draft (existing true). Requires PRODUCTION_PLAN (PERMISSION_DENIED) and the method read the explosion checks; refuses an organization or facility outside the user's (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a facility of another owner (FACILITY_OWNER), no product (PRODUCT_REQUIRED) or quantity (QUANTITY_INVALID), a product that cannot be produced (PRODUCT_NOT_USABLE), no released BOM at the date (METHOD_REQUIRED), several (METHOD_AMBIGUOUS) and an explosion with findings, a routing that is not released or that misses a line's operation (METHOD_INVALID).

parameter.description: The BOM's unit when empty.

parameter.name: productBomId
parameter.description: The product's MAIN (or only) released BOM when empty.

parameter.name: routingWorkEffortId
parameter.description: The BOM's routing when empty.

parameter.description: As of when the BOM and routing are read; now when empty.

parameter.name: result
parameter.description: resultCode CREATED, workEffortId, organizationPartyId, facilityId, productId, productBomId, routingWorkEffortId, methodDate, revision, lines, operationCount, and the operation fields.

service.description: Release a draft run (design-manufacturing WorkOrderDetail, §12.1): the product checked usable again; a release of the run's BOM, a phantom's BOM or its routings since the run's method date and in effect now is refused (METHOD_CHANGED) unless reexplode, which rewrites the draft lines and the WeptConsume/WeptProduce rows as of now and answers the draft for review (resultCode REEXPLODED, still WeInPlanning, at the next revision), to be released with that revision (R-SA-12); with no later release the lines are kept. The routings and BOMs checked are those the run was read from (productionMethodRefs: a phantom's routing whether or not a line names its operation). Then the operation children (WetTask, WeApproved, the run's owner, each with its routing operation, sequence and work center, audit-logged) from the routings as of the method date, the lines frozen (frozenDate) on their operations, the WorkEffortProduct rows rewritten from the lines, the frozen standard (the approved ProductStandardCost in effect now for the organization and facility, Products P9) and the release time stamped, the revision counted up, and the run WeApproved. A retry with the same operation key answers the first. Requires PRODUCTION_PLAN; refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), one not a draft (RUN_NOT_DRAFT), a changed revision (REVISION_CHANGED), a run with no lines (LINES_REQUIRED) and a product that cannot be produced (PRODUCT_NOT_USABLE).

parameter.name: result
parameter.description: resultCode RELEASED (or REEXPLODED with findings), workEffortId, statusId, releaseDate, methodDate, reexploded, revision, productStandardCostId, operationWorkEffortIds, lines, and the operation fields.

service.description: A production run as MaterialIssueReceipt and WorkOrderDetail show it: the run (status, facility, owner, revision, method date, release time, BOM, routing, the frozen standard's id and, with ACCOUNTING_VIEW, its unit cost, the demand links), its lines (material: issued, returned, remaining; output: received, remaining), its operations, and its issuances and receipts (a movement's value only with ACCOUNTING_VIEW). Requires PRODUCTION_VIEW or STOCK_ISSUE (the warehouse issues to it); refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

Issue a component to a released run's material line (design-manufacturing MaterialIssueReceipt Issue, M2): a new AssetIssuance per operation key and line, never added to an earlier one (D13), through mantle.product.AssetServices.issue#AssetToWorkEffort with the run's workEffortId (AssetIssuanceGlPost moves the cost to WIP, the run owning it), the line and operation and the quantity as entered on the issuance; the expiry gate (WarehousePolicy.expiryBlock) refuses an expired asset inside the issue (ASSET_EXPIRED). The quantity is in the stock unit, or in the line's unit through its exact conversion. Its cost event (record#ProductionCostEvent) references the hook's transaction (impl-manufacturing P6). A retry with the same operation key answers the first and writes no event. Requires STOCK_ISSUE; refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), one not released (RUN_NOT_RELEASED), a line of another run or role (LINE_INVALID), an operation of another run (OPERATION_INVALID), another unit (UNIT_CONVERSION), stock outside the user's facilities, not stock, or short (posting.stock's refusals), another product (PRODUCT_MISMATCH), stock that is not available, a quarantined one among them (HELD_STOCK), another owner's (OWNER_MISMATCH), more than is free (QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_AVAILABLE), more than the line has left beyond its scrap allowance (QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_REMAINING: the over-consumption tolerance of the ProductionPolicy the run was released under, none without a policy; impl-manufacturing P4) and a closed fiscal period today (PERIOD_CLOSED, read without locking).

parameter.name: quantityUomId
parameter.description: The stock unit when empty.

parameter.name: operationWorkEffortId
parameter.description: The line's operation when empty.

parameter.name: result
parameter.description: resultCode ISSUED, workEffortId, productionRunLineId, operationWorkEffortId, assetId, productId, lotId, quantity, assetIssuanceId, remaining (the line's, after), warnings, productionCostEventId, and the operation fields.

service.description: Return unused material from a run (design-manufacturing MaterialIssueReceipt Return unused, M2): a new receipt fact through mantle.product.AssetServices.receive#Asset, into the original asset where it is or into a new asset at the chosen location with the original acquireCost, lot and owner, with the run's workEffortId, AssetReceipt.sourceAssetIssuanceId and the issuance's operation, so AssetReceiptGlPost posts Dr inventory, Cr WIP at the original cost in the open period (D13, R-SA-02). Never cancel#AssetIssuance or an update of the issuance. After a provisional output receipt the return lowers the WIP the rest of the output takes (warning PROVISIONAL_TRUE_UP naming the receipts the cost close trues up); once all the output was received at a provisional cost it is refused (PROVISIONAL_CLOSED). Its cost event references the hook's transaction, and material with no cost, which would post nothing (F13), is refused (COST_UNAVAILABLE; impl-manufacturing P6). A retry with the same operation key answers the first. Requires STOCK_ISSUE; refuses an issuance that is not a work effort's or a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a closed or cancelled run (RUN_CLOSED), no quantity (QUANTITY_INVALID), more than is left of the issuance (QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_ISSUED), a facility of another owner (OWNER_MISMATCH), a closed or missing location (LOCATION_CLOSED, LOCATION_UNAVAILABLE, LOCATION_REQUIRED) and a closed fiscal period today (PERIOD_CLOSED, read without locking).

parameter.description: Empty returns into the original asset.

parameter.description: resultCode RETURNED, workEffortId, assetIssuanceId, assetId (the stock returned to), intoOriginal, productId, quantity, facilityId, locationSeqId, assetReceiptId, productionCostEventId, and the operation fields.

service.description: Receive a released run's output (design-manufacturing MaterialIssueReceipt Receive output, M2): through mantle.product.AssetServices.receive#Asset with the run's workEffortId and owner, at the run's frozen standard unit cost (its productStandardCostId, R-PRD-29); with no approved standard at the run's net WIP times the quantity over what is left to receive (the last receipt takes the rest), costProvisional; never without a cost (D12, R-SA-01, COST_UNAVAILABLE). The unit cost is kept at four decimals rounded down and the last unit received apart at the remainder's cost, so the receipts carry the value exactly (P6, F166). Output that needs inspection (the tracking policy's inspectionRequired or a published production template, P8) is received AstQuarantine into quarantine with an inspection of each receipt (QisWorkEffort); otherwise to the location given or the putaway resolver's. Serials one per unit (given, or generated from firstSerialNumber by P7's generate#TrackingIdentities rules), a lot by number. Each receipt carries the output line, the operation and the quantity as entered, and has its cost event, which references the hook's transaction and refuses a receipt without a cost (COST_UNAVAILABLE; impl-manufacturing P6). A retry with the same operation key answers the first. With the run's completeOnFinalReceipt policy flag (off by default), a running run that reconciles after the receipt is completed in the same transaction (completed). Requires STOCK_ISSUE; refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), one not released (RUN_NOT_RELEASED), a line of another run or role (LINE_INVALID, LINE_REQUIRED), a by-product, whose cost allocation is not built (BYPRODUCT_NOT_COSTED; P15), more than the line may still take (OVER_RECEIPT: its target and the ProductionPolicy's overproduction tolerance as of the release, with a supervisor's approval beyond it, less the good, held and lost quantity it accounts for; impl-manufacturing P7), a facility of another owner (OWNER_MISMATCH), the tracking checks (SERIAL_COUNT_MISMATCH, SERIAL_DUPLICATE, LOT_REQUIRED), the destination's refusals and a closed fiscal period today (PERIOD_CLOSED, read without locking).

service.description: Receive a subcontract's finished work (design-manufacturing SubcontractDetail, M2; Warehouse runs it from SubcontractShipmentDetail), in one transaction: the run's material lines (of the dispatch's operation, else of the run) issued from the vendor-custody facility the dispatch went to (P15) at the output's share of each line (backflush) or the supplier-reported actuals after review (materialQuantities by line), each through issue#ProductionMaterial under this operation's key; the output received through receive#ProductionOutput with the run's workEffortId and no transfer shipment, never on the service purchase line (which would value it at the PO price); then Purchasing's service acceptance (mantle.order.purchase.ServiceAcceptance, the accept#ServiceItem contract) of the dispatch's service order item with the output receipt and its inspection as evidence, under this entry point's check (§2). A retry with the same operation key answers the first, so the line is accepted once. Requires STOCK_ISSUE; refuses a shipment that is not a subcontract dispatch (NOT_SUBCONTRACT), a facility that is not in custody (NOT_CUSTODY), an order not with its custodian (CUSTODIAN_MISMATCH), stock missing at the vendor facility (MATERIAL_SHORT), and the refusals of the issue, the output receipt and the acceptance (QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_ORDERED, ORDER_CANCELLED, NOT_SERVICE).

service.description: The production policy in effect (design-manufacturing ProductionSettings) for an organization, at one of its facilities (a plant's override) or for a run, as of a date: each value with its source (the built-in default, the organization's default or a facility's override, with the row's dates and reason; traceRows has the display text), the row set at the exact scope (configuredPolicy, expectedFromDate) and its history. A run is read at its owner and facility as of its release time (a draft as of now), the policy it keeps; asOfDate reads another time. Requires PRODUCTION_VIEW or PRODUCTION_POLICY_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses an organization, facility or run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE). The production guards read the policy through ProductionPolicy.js's runPolicy, which checks no permission.

parameter.description: Empty for the organization's default

parameter.description: The value of each field in effect

parameter.name: sources
parameter.description: Each field a row sets: level (organization or facility), facilityId, facilityName, fromDate, thruDate, changeReason

service.description: A dated production policy change for an organization (no facility) or one of its facilities (a plant's override): consumption (manual or backflush, the issue point, the over-consumption and overproduction tolerances in percent, substitute approval, the quality defaults, and the completion-on-final-receipt and strict-release flags), time and cost (time logging, machine runtime, the work type, piece rate, the labor cost flag, estimate refresh and close approval) and planning (horizon, time fence, shortage release, calendar, lead-time basis and freshness limit). An empty value inherits. The row in effect at the start ends there; the new row holds its values with the changes, every field audit-logged with the reason. A released run keeps the row of its release time. Requires PRODUCTION_POLICY_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses an organization or facility outside the user's (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a stale expectedFromDate (POLICY_CHANGED), a start before now, a second row at the same time and an invalid value (POLICY_INVALID).

parameter.name: expectedFromDate
parameter.description: The fromDate of the row in effect at this scope when the form was read, empty when none

parameter.name: policyGroup
parameter.description: consumption, timeAndCost or planning: only that group's fields change (one ProductionSettings form); empty changes every field given

service.description: The production reason codes of an organization as of a date (design-manufacturing ReasonCodes): each code with its row in effect and display text, by sequence and code; inactive codes (no row in effect, with their latest row) only with includeInactive; with reasonCode, that code's dated rows (history). Requires PRODUCTION_VIEW or PRODUCTION_POLICY_EDIT; refuses an organization outside the user's (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

Add, change or deactivate production reason codes of an organization, each reason on its own: a new code (reasonName and reasonCategoryEnumId required), a change (a dated row from fromDate, now when empty, that ends the one in effect) or, with active N, a deactivation that ends the row in effect. A reason is never deleted, so the events that name it keep it; each row's fields are audit-logged with the reason. Every reason is checked before any is written, and one refused is named in results (REASON_INVALID, also for a deactivation before a change already scheduled, REASON_CHANGED for a stale expectedFromDate, REASON_INACTIVE) while the others are stored; the save is refused when none is. Requires PRODUCTION_POLICY_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses an organization outside the user's (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

parameter.name: reasons
parameter.description: Maps of reasonCode, reasonName, reasonCategoryEnumId, equipmentFault, plannedStop, approvalThreshold, sequenceNum, active (N deactivates), fromDate and expectedFromDate

parameter.name: results
parameter.description: Each reason: reasonCode, resultCode (STORED, CHANGED, DEACTIVATED or REFUSED), errorCode and message when refused

service.description: The production runs of the user's organizations (design-manufacturing WorkOrders), paged, each with its product, planned and good quantity, what is left, due date, facility, status and readiness, as display text. Open runs by default (statusId all, or a comma list, for others); a plant takes the lines under it. The saved finds' filters: ready (released, no short line), late (open and past due), blocked (on hold or a line released short), mine (the user assigned on the run or an operation), productId (By product); also assigneePartyId, demandOrderId (a sales order's supplying runs), text (id or name, ignoring case) and the due range. Requires PRODUCTION_VIEW (PERMISSION_DENIED).

A run's lifecycle as WorkOrderDetail shows it: the run (status, revision, product, planned, good and left, dates, method and release time, demand links, staged approval), each action open from its status with what it would do (impact) or why it is refused (reasonCode, message: the user's permission, a reason to give, the release gate's findings, facts), its shortages while a draft, its stock and time facts, and its status history with the reasons. Reads only. Requires PRODUCTION_VIEW; refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

The one path to a production run's status (design-manufacturing WorkOrderDetail Lifecycle, the WorkOrders board and bulk action; R-MFG-11): an action, or the move to toStatusId a board makes, on the run at its expected revision, with an operation key (a retry answers the first result). release (PRODUCTION_PLAN) runs the release gate and then release#ProductionOrder: the product usable (PRODUCT_NOT_USABLE), the method valid as of the method date (METHOD_INVALID), no later release of its methods (METHOD_CHANGED, with reexplode offered: reexplode rewrites the draft as of now, REEXPLODED, to review and release again), and the shortage policy in effect at the release time: all components covered, or a staged release a supervisor approved at this revision (SHORTAGE otherwise), or a staged release by the policy (PsrStaged); a staged release leaves its short lines blocked for issue until the stock covers them, and the release notifies the organization's supervisors (ProductionRelease). unrelease (PRODUCTION_PLAN) takes a released run that has no stock or time fact (RUN_HAS_FACTS) back to a draft, its operations cancelled and its lines unfrozen. start, hold (a reason), resume (as released before a start, as running after), cancel (a reason; a draft, released or held run with no fact) and complete need PRODUCTION_SUPERVISE; complete (impl-manufacturing P7) needs each output line reconciled, target = good + held + remaining + approved loss with nothing remaining (QUANTITIES_UNRECONCILED; finishRemainder records what is left as an approved loss with the reason) and nothing held awaiting disposition (OUTPUT_HELD), no loss waiting for approval (LOSS_PENDING), no operation running or held (OPERATION_OPEN; those not reported complete with it) and each material line issued (MATERIAL_UNISSUED, unless acceptMaterialVariance); close is the cost close's (CLOSE_BY_COST_CLOSE). requestStaged (PRODUCTION_PLAN) asks the supervisors to approve a staged release of a short draft (ProductionStagedRelease); approveStaged (PRODUCTION_SUPERVISE) approves it at the next revision. Refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), no revision (REVISION_REQUIRED) or a changed one (REVISION_CHANGED), an action from another status (STATUS_INVALID, RUN_NOT_DRAFT), a generic transition such as In Planning to Complete (TRANSITION_INVALID), a missing reason (REASON_REQUIRED) or an inactive reason code (REASON_INVALID), and a user without the action's permission (PERMISSION_DENIED).

parameter.name: action
parameter.description: release, unrelease, start, hold, resume, cancel, complete, close, requestStaged or approveStaged; else toStatusId

parameter.name: toStatusId
parameter.description: A board move: the status the card was moved to

parameter.name: reasonCode
parameter.description: An active production reason of the run's organization

parameter.name: finishRemainder
parameter.description: complete: record what is left of each output line as an approved loss first

parameter.name: acceptMaterialVariance
parameter.description: complete: accept the material not issued as a variance

parameter.name: result
parameter.description: resultCode (RELEASED, REEXPLODED, UNRELEASED, STARTED, HELD, RESUMED, CANCELLED, COMPLETED, REQUESTED or APPROVED), workEffortId, action, fromStatusId, statusId, revision; for a release releaseDate, operationWorkEffortIds, staged and shortages; and the operation fields.

service.description: One action on several runs (design-manufacturing WorkOrders Selection): each run through transition#ProductionOrder in its own transaction under "operationKey/workEffortId", at the revision given for it in expectedRevisions or its current one, so a retry answers the runs already done. A result per run: outcome success, blocked (SHORTAGE, METHOD_CHANGED, RUN_HAS_FACTS, RUN_STARTED, or a completion's QUANTITIES_UNRECONCILED, OUTPUT_HELD, LOSS_PENDING, MATERIAL_UNISSUED, OPERATION_OPEN) or failed, with its reason code and message; one failure does not stop the others. Requires PRODUCTION_PLAN or PRODUCTION_SUPERVISE; each run checks its action's own permission.

Change a draft run's header (design-manufacturing Overview UpdateRun): its name, description, priority, estimated start and due dates, and its facility (one of the run owner's). A field left out is kept; the revision counts up. Released work changes only through amend#ProductionOrder (P9) and a schedule change (P12). Requires PRODUCTION_PLAN; refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), one not a draft (RUN_NOT_DRAFT), a changed revision (REVISION_CHANGED, REVISION_REQUIRED), an empty name (NAME_REQUIRED), a due date before the start (DATES_INVALID) and another owner's facility (FACILITY_OWNER).

parameter.name: result
parameter.description: resultCode STORED, workEffortId, revision and the operation fields.

service.description: Assign equipment to an open run, or end its assignment (design-manufacturing Overview Equipment): a WorkEffortAssetAssign row from the given or estimated start to the given or estimated due date, Assigned; end ends the current one now (a future one at its start). The revision counts up. Requires PRODUCTION_PLAN; refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a run done or cancelled (RUN_CLOSED), a changed revision (REVISION_CHANGED, REVISION_REQUIRED), equipment not at a facility of the run's owner (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), stock (EQUIPMENT_INVALID), equipment deactivated, on hold, delivered or in maintenance now (EQUIPMENT_BLOCKED), equipment another open run holds over the same time (EQUIPMENT_OVERLAP), dates out of order (DATES_INVALID), a second assignment (ALREADY_ASSIGNED) and an end of none (NOT_ASSIGNED).

parameter.name: result
parameter.description: resultCode ASSIGNED or ENDED, workEffortId, assetId, revision and the operation fields.

service.description: The guarded assignment of a run's people (design-manufacturing Overview People): a supervisor (Manager) or operator (Assignee) who is a person of the run's organization, through mantle.work.WorkEffortServices.add#WorkEffortParty, or with remove their removal through remove#WorkEffortParty. An operator lacking a skill the run's operations require is assigned with a warning (the start checks it, P10). An assignment grants no stock, cost or release permission. The revision counts up. Requires PRODUCTION_PLAN or PRODUCTION_SUPERVISE; refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a run done or cancelled (RUN_CLOSED), a changed revision (REVISION_CHANGED, REVISION_REQUIRED), another role (ROLE_INVALID) and a party that is not a person of the organization (PARTY_UNAVAILABLE).

parameter.name: result

service.description: A run's equipment assignments and its supervisors and operators, current and ended, for Overview. Requires PRODUCTION_VIEW; refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

A run's operations (design-manufacturing Operations): a released run's operation children, a draft's the routing operations it will release, each with its sequence, work center, predecessors (the routing's as of the method date), planned and actual dates, status, the material lines it consumes and its readiness with the reason: the run not released or on hold, a predecessor not done, a line released short, else ready. A run with no routing has none (routed false). Requires PRODUCTION_VIEW or PRODUCTION_OPERATE; refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

The pick sheet of a run (design-manufacturing §11): each material line with its operation, what it requires and has left, and the available stock of the run's owner to pick for it at the facilities the run nets against (its line and the plant above it), oldest receipt first, with what stays short. Reads only. Requires PRODUCTION_VIEW or STOCK_ISSUE; refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

Write the cost event of a source record of a production run (design-manufacturing ProductionCosts, §12 M8; crosscut CX-COST), inside the transaction of the fact that causes it: the production guards call it for each issuance (issue#ProductionMaterial, and receive#SubcontractOutput's material through it), return (return#UnusedMaterial) and output receipt (receive#ProductionOutput). The event is derived from the source alone: the run, line, operation, product, quantity, the asset's cost as its rate (an output's rate row the run's frozen standard), the amount signed for the run's WIP and the AcctgTrans the movement's hook posted (posting nothing again; PclNotPosted when the hook posted nothing, and unvalued without a cost). One event per source, component and revision: a second call answers the first (existing true). Internal: it checks no permission, the caller's guard did. Refuses a source that is not a production run's movement (SOURCE_INVALID) and a receipt without a cost, which would post nothing (COST_UNAVAILABLE, F13); an unknown source entity is an error.

service.description: A production run's cost evidence (design-manufacturing ProductionCosts Costs and CloseReview): the run, its cost events (type, component, product, quantity, source, valuation and ledger state; each amount, rate and ledger link only with ACCOUNTING_VIEW), the frozen estimate it was released with for its output quantity (with Products' cost read: PRODUCT_COST_VIEW, _ESTIMATE or _APPROVE, ACCOUNTING_VIEW or ACCOUNTING_GL_POST), the actual cost by component with the material issued and returned, the output's relief and the WIP balance (with ACCOUNTING_VIEW), the estimate against the actual (with both), the exceptions that stand in the way of the cost close (unvalued, not posted and awaiting-close events) and the cost review (its status, whether the user may request it now and why not, a closed-period warning). A value the user may not read is left out, never zero. Requires PRODUCTION_VIEW, PRODUCTION_COST_REVIEW or ACCOUNTING_VIEW (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

A closed fiscal period of the accounting date is a warning (PERIOD_CLOSED). A retry with the same operation key answers the first. Requires PRODUCTION_COST_REVIEW (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a changed revision (REVISION_CHANGED), a draft (RUN_NOT_RELEASED), a closed or cancelled run (RUN_CLOSED), a run with no cost events (NO_COST_EVENTS) and one whose review was already requested at this revision (REVIEW_REQUESTED).

service.description: Open, close, approve or correct a production stop (design-manufacturing Downtime ReportStop, §12 M6; review Y3). open: a stop of a work center of the user's organizations from fromDate (now when empty), with its optional equipment (an asset that is not stock, of the center's organization), run and operation (an operation of that run, a production run of the organization) and the organization's active downtime or hold reason as of its start, whose category, equipment fault and planned stop it keeps; with thruDate it is recorded closed. An equipment-fault reason with an asset records the asset's one open outage, or links it, in the same transaction (ResourceBookingServices.record#ResourceUnavailability). close: the end of an open stop (now when empty); its request, maintenance and outage stay open and no timer starts; an ended stop longer than its reason's approval threshold (minutes, of the reason row at its start) needs approval (approvalRequired). approve: a supervisor's approval of such a stop. correct: a new row with the corrected interval, reason, equipment and note, keeping the reporter and report date, and the corrected row kept with its values, marked PdtCorrected and superseded by the new one. A retry with the same operation key answers the first. Requires PRODUCTION_OPERATE or PRODUCTION_SUPERVISE to open and close, PRODUCTION_SUPERVISE to approve and correct (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses an unknown action (ACTION_INVALID), a center, equipment, run or stop outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a facility that is not a work center (CENTER_INVALID), stock or another organization's equipment (ASSET_INVALID), an operation of another run (OPERATION_INVALID), a run of another organization (RUN_INVALID), a reason that is not an active downtime or hold reason (REASON_INVALID), a start or end in the future or an end before the start (INTERVAL_INVALID), a changed revision (REVISION_CHANGED), a stop already ended (DOWNTIME_CLOSED), one already corrected (DOWNTIME_CORRECTED), a correction without its reason (REASON_REQUIRED), and an approval of a stop not ended (DOWNTIME_OPEN), one that needs none (APPROVAL_NOT_REQUIRED) or one already approved (DOWNTIME_APPROVED).

Each row has its display text (center, equipment, work, reason name and category, from, through, duration, state and color, reporter, approval, correction, outage, maintenance and request) and what the user may do with it (canClose, canApprove, canCorrect, canRequestMaintenance, and suggestMaintenance for an equipment fault of a machine). With productionDowntimeId, that stop (a corrected one too) and its correction chain in history, from the first report to the row in force. The stop keeps the maintenance and the request. Nothing closes the stop or starts a timer. A retry with the same operation key answers the first. Requires PRODUCTION_OPERATE or PRODUCTION_SUPERVISE (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses a stop or equipment outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a corrected stop (DOWNTIME_CORRECTED), a stop whose maintenance was already requested (MAINTENANCE_REQUESTED), no equipment (ASSET_REQUIRED), stock, another organization's equipment or equipment other than the stop's (ASSET_INVALID) and no problem (PROBLEM_REQUIRED).

service.description: A run's quantities (design-manufacturing Quantities OutputPlan, ByProducts, §12.2): each output and by-product line's target, received, accepted good and produced-held (its receipts' assets by their status now, less what was scrapped back), approved process loss, scrap and rework, losses waiting for approval, what is left, overproduction, the policy's tolerance, a supervisor's approval beyond it and what it may still take; each material line's required, issued, returned, net, scrapped in WIP and remaining quantity; the quantity events and losses (a loss's cost only with ACCOUNTING_VIEW); the reconciliation the completion needs (reconciled, the refusal and whether Finish remainder or the material variance is offered); with Products' cost read the by-products' allocation estimate (by quantity; the actual allocation is the cost close's, P15); and what the user may do. Reads only. Requires PRODUCTION_VIEW or PRODUCTION_OPERATE; refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

A draft run's secondary output (PrlrOutput) or by-product (PrlrByproduct) line, added, changed or with remove taken off (design-manufacturing Quantities AddOutput, ByProducts): its product, quantity and unit with the exact conversion to the stock unit, and the routing operation that yields it; the WeptProduce rows rewritten and the revision counted up. The run's own product is not changed here (OUTPUT_PRIMARY). A retry with the same operation key answers the first. Requires PRODUCTION_PLAN; refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a changed revision (REVISION_REQUIRED, REVISION_CHANGED), a released run (RUN_NOT_DRAFT), a line of another run or role (LINE_INVALID), another role (ROLE_INVALID), no product (PRODUCT_REQUIRED) or quantity (QUANTITY_INVALID), a unit without a conversion (UNIT_CONVERSION) and an operation not in the run's routings (OPERATION_INVALID).

service.description: Record what a released or running run produced on an output line (design-manufacturing Quantities Reconcile, §12.2), in one transaction: process loss, scrap (before it was stock) and rework through their losses (record#ProductionLoss's rules: a reason, an approval above the reason's threshold), then good output received through receive#ProductionOutput and pending (produced-held) output received into quarantine with its inspection (hold), each under this operation's key so a retry receives nothing twice, and a quantity event for each. Output beyond what the line may still take (its target, the policy's overproduction tolerance and a supervisor's approval, less what it accounts for) records nothing but an overproduction request, which notifies the supervisors (ProductionOverproduction; resultCode APPROVAL_REQUESTED). The receipt can complete the run under the completeOnFinalReceipt flag (completed). Requires PRODUCTION_OPERATE, and STOCK_ISSUE for the receipts; refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), one not released or running (RUN_NOT_RELEASED), a changed revision when one is given (REVISION_CHANGED), a line of another run (LINE_INVALID), an operation of another run (OPERATION_INVALID), a negative quantity (QUANTITY_INVALID), none at all (QUANTITY_REQUIRED), and the loss and receipt refusals.

History is never rewritten and set#ProducedProductQuantity is never called (F8). A retry with the same operation key answers the first. Requires PRODUCTION_PLAN; refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a changed revision (REVISION_REQUIRED, REVISION_CHANGED), a draft or a done run (RUN_NOT_RELEASED), no reason (REASON_REQUIRED) or an inactive reason code (REASON_INVALID), a line that is not an output (LINE_INVALID), no target (QUANTITY_INVALID) and the same target (NO_CHANGE).

service.description: Record a loss inside an open run (design-manufacturing ScrapLoss RecordLoss, R-MFG-20; §12 M2 and M6), by its path: PltComponentScrap, issued material of a material line scrapped in WIP, no more than its net issue less what was scrapped, with a scrap cost event (record#ProductionCostEvent, PcetMaterialScrap at its asset's or the line's issued cost, awaiting the cost close) and no stock movement; PltOutputScrap of an output asset of this run, received or held, issued back to the run (issue#AssetToWorkEffort with the run's workEffortId and the loss, whose hook posts it into WIP so the loss reaches production variance at the cost close, never a Warehouse adjustment; needs STOCK_ISSUE), or of output scrapped before it was stock (no asset); PltProcessLoss, a quantity only; and PltRework, units sent to rework (reworkWorkEffortId). A loss in output units writes its quantity event. The reason is an active production reason of the run's owner in the loss's category, or a reason's text; above the reason's approval threshold (a percent of the line's quantity) the loss waits for a supervisor (PlsPending, the ProductionLossApproval notice) with no effect until approve#ProductionException, unless a supervisor records it. Free stock outside a run is scrapped in Warehouse (scrap#Asset). A retry with the same operation key answers the first. Requires PRODUCTION_OPERATE; refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), one not open (RUN_NOT_OPEN), an unknown type (LOSS_TYPE_INVALID), no quantity (QUANTITY_INVALID), a line of another run or role (LINE_INVALID), more than was issued (QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_ISSUED), an asset not of the line or run (ASSET_INVALID), stock outside the user's facilities or short (posting.stock's refusals, QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_AVAILABLE), another owner's (OWNER_MISMATCH), an inactive or other-category reason (REASON_INVALID), no reason (REASON_REQUIRED) and a closed fiscal period today (PERIOD_CLOSED).

The decision marks the notices read. A retry with the same operation key answers the first. Requires PRODUCTION_SUPERVISE; refuses a record outside the user's organizations or missing (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE, RECORD_REQUIRED), one already decided (NOT_PENDING), another decision (DECISION_INVALID), a refusal without a reason (REASON_REQUIRED), a run no longer open (RUN_NOT_OPEN) and the loss's own refusals; with workEffortId, a record of another work order (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

service.description: The production losses of the user's organizations (design-manufacturing ScrapLoss Losses), newest first, paged: by run, operation, work center, product, reason, loss type, status and loss date range, each with its type, product and lot, quantity, reason, status, its effect (a scrap cost event, the output issued back, a quantity only) and, with ACCOUNTING_VIEW only, its cost. Each loss's run is checked against the user's organizations. Requires PRODUCTION_VIEW or PRODUCTION_OPERATE.

A run's finished (its own product), secondary (another output or a by-product) and WIP (an operation, or the run) labels (design-manufacturing §11; on Products P11's label contract: the product-50x30 template and a Code 128 of the asset, operation or run id): each output asset received and still on hand with its product, quantity, unit, lot, serial, owner, facility, run, operation and status; a held asset's label says it is held and not accepted, so no label claims acceptance before disposition. kind (finished, secondary, wip) and assetIds narrow them. Reads only. Requires PRODUCTION_VIEW or STOCK_ISSUE; refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

A run's material lines as Components and MaterialIssueReceipt show them (design-manufacturing Components): each line's operation, product, required quantity in the stock unit with the scrap allowance of the run's policy, issued, returned and remaining, the stock free for it at the facilities the run nets against (its facility and, for a line, the plant above it), shared in line order, what is short, the owner's stock held there by status apart (quarantine, on hold, defective; never from available to promise, R-MFG-24), a staged release's short quantity, and whether a planner added it by hand; with withStock, the available stock each line may be issued from, oldest lot expiry first. Also the run's consumption policy (manual or backflush, the issue point), a draft's routing operations, and whether the user may add lines (PRODUCTION_PLAN, a draft) or issue (STOCK_ISSUE, a released run). Requires PRODUCTION_VIEW or STOCK_ISSUE; refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

Add, change or remove a manual material line of a draft run (design-manufacturing Components AddMaterial): the component (a stocked product of the organization's, not what the run makes), its quantity in the product's stock unit, the routing operation that consumes it, the facility its stock is staged from (the run owner's) and an instruction. The line is marked manual, so a re-explosion of the method keeps it; the planning rows (WeptConsume) are rewritten and the revision counts up, so a staged approval is asked again. A line from the method is changed only through the method. A retry with the same operation key answers the first. Requires PRODUCTION_PLAN; refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), one not a draft (RUN_NOT_DRAFT), a changed revision (REVISION_CHANGED, REVISION_REQUIRED), a line of another run or role (LINE_INVALID), a method line (LINE_NOT_MANUAL), no product (PRODUCT_REQUIRED), another organization's product (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), one that is not stocked (NOT_STOCK) or the run's own output (PRODUCT_INVALID), no quantity (QUANTITY_INVALID), another unit (UNIT_CONVERSION), an operation not of the routing (OPERATION_INVALID) and a facility of another owner (FACILITY_OWNER).

service.description: What a backflush of a released run would issue (design-manufacturing MaterialIssueReceipt Preview backflush): each material line's exact remaining quantity, of one operation's lines or all, with the lots it would issue from (the run owner's available stock at the run's facilities, oldest lot expiry first, then the oldest receipt; expired stock left out), and the findings that leave nothing to confirm: a policy that issues by hand (BACKFLUSH_NOT_POLICY), a line the available stock does not cover (SHORTFALL: held stock is never issued, also at a facility that allows issue beyond quantity on hand, F12), a staged short line still short (LINE_STAGED_SHORT) and nothing left (NOTHING_TO_ISSUE). The previewKey names the run's revision and every pick for backflush#ProductionMaterials. Reads only. Requires STOCK_ISSUE; refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), one not released (RUN_NOT_RELEASED) and an operation of another run (OPERATION_INVALID).

Confirm a backflush preview (design-manufacturing MaterialIssueReceipt): the preview is made again and must match the previewKey given (PREVIEW_CHANGED when the stock or the run changed), then each pick is issued through issue#ProductionMaterial, a new issuance per line and lot with its cost event, all in this transaction, so a refusal of any (a held asset, a shortfall, a staged short line, a closed period) issues none. A retry with the same operation key answers the first and issues nothing more. Requires STOCK_ISSUE; refuses what preview#ProductionBackflush finds (BACKFLUSH_NOT_POLICY, SHORTFALL, LINE_STAGED_SHORT, NOTHING_TO_ISSUE) and what the issue guard refuses.

Requires PRODUCTION_VIEW (PERMISSION_DENIED).
